//: Copy to dun.json (committed, describes the PROJECT) or .dun/dun.local.json (gitignored, describes THIS MACHINE). Both are optional; with neither, dun knows three servers — poly-lsp (poly-lsp-mcp), shell (mcpshell), raglit — and starts only shell. Config that still says code or docs is read as poly-lsp and raglit. /raglit auto and /poly-lsp auto write the autostart flag below. Here autostart and via are the PROJECT switch's starting value: the project's own switch (/mcp on|off --project, saved under $DUN_HOME/projects/<id>/) overrides them, and a session's switch overrides that.

servers.//: Spawn a server at startup. poly-lsp and raglit are opt-in by default; this is what /poly-lsp auto writes.
Override a built-in by reusing its id. Fields you omit are INHERITED, so pointing at a different binary does not mean restating its args.
Add a project-specific server. {{workspace}} and {{raglit_home}} are substituted at spawn — the same token llm-bench toolsets use.
Drop a built-in you do not want. One line, rather than re-listing the servers you are keeping.

//commit: How /worktree commit writes its message. One throwaway LLM call sees the porcelain status, the diff vs HEAD (bounded) and the last few user messages, and you approve the result before anything is committed. Omit the whole section for conventional commits.

commit.//format: A built-in style: 'conventional' (the default — type(scope): subject + a body saying WHY) or 'plain' (no type/scope prefix).
commit.//instruction: Free text handed to the model verbatim, for a project whose convention is its own. Wins over format — the specific statement beats the named one.

//files: The built-in file tools (file_read, file_edit, file_write, file_grep, file_list; file_delete and file_move when listed), rooted at the session's working tree. Omit for the defaults. Merged field-by-field; ignore patterns from every layer add up.

files.//tools: Which tools. [] turns them all off. delete and move are off unless listed.
files.//read_only: Keep read, grep and list only.
files.//read_max: Bytes one ranged read returns (default 65536); unranged_max, grep_max and list_max work the same way.
files.//ignore: gitignore-syntax patterns hidden from grep and list, on top of .gitignore.

//rag: What /raglit gives the docs index (raglit). Skipped automatically: dependency, build and cache directories by name (node_modules, .venv, dist, build, target beside a Cargo.toml or pom.xml, ...), any directory whose files add up to more than max_dir_files or max_dir_mb (skipped whole, at the highest such directory; the workspace root never), files over max_file_kb, and binary files. Each skip is named in the /raglit on message. Merged field-by-field; include and exclude from every layer add up.

rag.//include: gitignore-syntax patterns that override every automatic skip. Inside a dependency or build directory, only a pattern naming it or a path in it ("node_modules/foo/") reaches; a bare "*.json" does not.
rag.//exclude: gitignore-syntax patterns never indexed. Wins over include.

//mounts: Extra local paths that must be accessible from both the worktree (symlink) and Docker container (volume mount). go.mod replace directives are auto-discovered — declare mounts here for non-Go projects or to override the auto-detected source path.

mounts.//: source is the host path (relative to repo root or absolute), name is the symlink/volume name. Docker mounts at /<name>.
mounts.name: agentkit
